title: AssertBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Assertion in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to verified true facts from the FEVEROUS dataset under different directional framings (neutral, user explicitly claiming the fact is correct, and user explicitly claiming the fact is incorrect) to measure the model's susceptibility to social influence and whether it alters its factual assessment to agree with the user.

Measuring changes in the model's accuracy and calibration error when a user presents misleading or contradictory assertions about static facts, assessing if the model acts as a source of confirmation bias rather than maintaining epistemic robustness.
